title: Dimension of the comparison quotient fibre
statement: Dimension calculation for a comparison quotient at the canonical fibre prime

proof.text: Apply the polynomial quotient dimension and height-difference theorem to the comparison presentation. The localization bijection identifies the relevant prime chains, and the quotient by c equations has fibre dimension n − c.

mathlib_searches.query: dimension of polynomial quotient by c equations at fibre prime
topological Krull dimension polynomial quotient height difference

lean.statement:
theorem equationCount_comparison_dimension
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S) {n c : ℕ} {f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R}
    (π : (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)) →ₐ[R] S)
    (u : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective π) (hu : π u ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (hbij : Function.Bijective
      (IsLocalization.Away.mapₐ (Localization.Away u) (Localization.Away (π u)) π u))
    (hle : c ≤ n) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt
      (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R
        (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
        ((q.comap π.toRingHom).comap
          (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))))
        ⟨q.comap π.toRingHom, rfl⟩) = (n - c : ℕ)
